description: Backend foundation + shared TS types: attach bins[] to every hub (hubs.js attachAvailableItems), add the HUB_BIN path to reportUnfit, add maybeAutoRoute throttle + unclaimed + routeUnclaimed donor actions, extend wasteJobs with pickup_type/hub fields, and make collect hub-bin-aware; plus the matching types in src/lib/api.ts (HubBin, Hub.bins, UnclaimedItem, ReportUnfitResponse.destination/hub fields, WasteJob.pickup_type/hub fields). This is the prerequisite for FEAT-002..005. All other features read these types and call these endpoints — do them all here so api/data.js and api.ts are each edited once.
steps: api/hubs.js: in attachAvailableItems(hubs), after the last_checkin query (reuse the in-scope ids/ph), run `SELECT bin_id, hub_id, bin_type, label, max_weight_kg, free_kg FROM v_hub_bin_status WHERE hub_id IN (${ph})` with `ids`; group rows by hub_id into a Map; in the final per-hub loop set `h.bins = binMap.get(h.hub_id) || []` (leave DECIMAL max_weight_kg/free_kg as strings). Keep available_items and last_checkin unchanged.

src/lib/api.ts: add `export interface HubBin { bin_id:number; bin_type:'ANIMAL'|'BIOGAS'; label:string; max_weight_kg:string|number; free_kg:string|number }`; add `bins?: HubBin[]` to `Hub`; add `export interface UnclaimedItem { listing_id:number; food_name:string; quantity_remaining:string|number; quantity_unit:string; kg_left:string|number; expires_at:string; minutes_left:string|number }`; extend `ReportUnfitResponse` with `destination:'DONOR_SITE'|'HUB_BIN'` and optional `hub_name?:string; hub_address?:string; bin_label?:string`; extend `WasteJob` with `pickup_type:'HUB_BIN'|'DONOR_SITE'` and optional `hub_id?:number|null; hub_name?:string|null; hub_address?:string|null; bin_label?:string|null`.

api/data.js: at module top after the `needVolunteerRole` helper and before `module.exports`, add `let _lastAutoRoute = 0;` and `async function maybeAutoRoute(){ if(Date.now()-_lastAutoRoute < 10*60*1000) return; _lastAutoRoute = Date.now(); try{ await pool.query('CALL sp_route_expired_food()'); }catch(_){} }`. Also add `async function dropIntoBin(conn, binId, wasteId, grade){ const [[b]]=await conn.query('SELECT bin_type FROM HUB_BIN WHERE bin_id=?',[binId]); if(!b) throw new Error('Bin not found'); const wants = grade==='ANIMAL_OK'?'ANIMAL':'BIOGAS'; if(b.bin_type!==wants) throw new Error('This bin does not accept ${grade} food'); await conn.query('INSERT INTO HUB_BIN_DROP (bin_id, waste_id) VALUES (?, ?)',[binId, wasteId]); }` (trigger errors propagate as sqlMessage via the outer errJson).

api/data.js reportUnfit: destructure `destination = 'DONOR_SITE'` and `bin_id` from body; capture the WASTE_ROUTING insert id (`const [wrIns] = await conn.query(INSERT INTO WASTE_ROUTING ...); const wasteId = wrIns.insertId;`); after the `UPDATE FOOD_LISTING SET status='ROUTED'` and before commit, if `destination==='HUB_BIN'` validate `Number(bin_id)` is present (else rollback+400 'bin_id is required for HUB_BIN') then `await dropIntoBin(conn, Number(bin_id), wasteId, grade)`. After commit: if HUB_BIN fetch `SELECT ch.name AS hub_name, ch.address AS hub_address, hb.label AS bin_label FROM HUB_BIN hb JOIN COMMUNITY_HUB ch ON ch.hub_id=hb.hub_id WHERE hb.bin_id=?` and return `{partner_name, route_type, kg, destination:'HUB_BIN', hub_name, hub_address, bin_label}`; default path returns `{partner_name, route_type, kg, destination:'DONOR_SITE'}`. The existing case try/catch already does rollback+throw (top-level catch returns errJson).
api/data.js myListings: add `await maybeAutoRoute();` as the first line of the case (before the existing query).

api/data.js add `case 'unclaimed'` (DONOR): `need('DONOR'); await maybeAutoRoute(); return res.json(await q('SELECT l.listing_id, l.food_name, v.quantity_remaining, l.quantity_unit, v.quantity_remaining * l.weight_per_unit_kg AS kg_left, l.expires_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, NOW(), l.expires_at) AS minutes_left FROM FOOD_LISTING l JOIN v_listing_remaining v ON v.listing_id=l.listing_id WHERE l.donor_id=? AND l.status='AVAILABLE' AND v.quantity_remaining>0 AND l.hub_id IS NULL AND l.expires_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL 2 HOUR ORDER BY l.expires_at', [u.pid]) || []);`

api/data.js add `case 'routeUnclaimed'` (DONOR): destructure `{listing_id, grade, destination='DONOR_SITE', bin_id}`; validate grade in ['ANIMAL_OK','BIOGAS_ONLY'] and destination in ['DONOR_SITE','HUB_BIN']; open conn transaction; verify ownership — `SELECT listing_id, donor_id, status, hub_id FROM FOOD_LISTING WHERE listing_id=?` must be donor's, status AVAILABLE, hub_id NULL (else rollback + 4xx with a clear message); get kg_left via `SELECT v.quantity_remaining * l.weight_per_unit_kg AS kg_left FROM v_listing_remaining v JOIN FOOD_LISTING l USING(listing_id) WHERE l.listing_id=?`; get category_id from the listing; run the same fn_pick_partner logic as reportUnfit (FARM then ANIMAL_SHELTER fallback for ANIMAL_OK; BIOGAS for BIOGAS_ONLY); `INSERT INTO WASTE_ROUTING (listing_id, route_type, partner_id, condition_grade, quantity_kg) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)` capturing wasteId; `UPDATE FOOD_LISTING SET status='ROUTED' WHERE listing_id=?`; if HUB_BIN validate bin_id + `dropIntoBin`; commit; after commit if HUB_BIN fetch hub_name/hub_address/bin_label as in reportUnfit; return same shape as reportUnfit (with destination + HUB_BIN fields). Keep the case try/catch{rollback;throw}finally{release}.

api/data.js wasteJobs: add `await maybeAutoRoute();` first; replace the SELECT with the spec query adding `CASE WHEN hbd.drop_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'HUB_BIN' ELSE 'DONOR_SITE' END AS pickup_type, hb.hub_id, ch.name AS hub_name, ch.address AS hub_address, hb.label AS bin_label` via `LEFT JOIN HUB_BIN_DROP hbd ON hbd.waste_id=wr.waste_id LEFT JOIN HUB_BIN hb ON hb.bin_id=hbd.bin_id LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_HUB ch ON ch.hub_id=hb.hub_id`, `ORDER BY pickup_type DESC, wr.waste_id`.

api/data.js collect: after the existing single-partner `SELECT DISTINCT wr.partner_id ...` check, run `SELECT DISTINCT hbd.bin_id, hb.hub_id, CASE WHEN hbd.drop_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'HUB_BIN' ELSE 'DONOR_SITE' END AS pickup_type FROM WASTE_ROUTING wr LEFT JOIN HUB_BIN_DROP hbd ON hbd.waste_id=wr.waste_id LEFT JOIN HUB_BIN hb ON hb.bin_id=hbd.bin_id WHERE wr.waste_id IN (${placeholders})` with waste_ids. Compute `types` set and non-null `hubIds` set. If types==={'DONOR_SITE'}: source_type='DONOR_SITE', hub_id=null. Else if types==={'HUB_BIN'} && hubIds.size===1: source_type='HUB', hub_id=[...hubIds][0]. Else: `await conn.rollback(); return res.status(400).json({ error:'Collect hub-bin items and donor-site items separately, one hub at a time' });`. Change the WASTE_COLLECTION INSERT to bind `source_type` and `hub_id` (add the hub_id column to the INSERT + values). Keep `receiptRef = RCPT-${partnerId}-${Date.now()}` and the rest of collect unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes (tsc + vite): the new api.ts types compile and existing pages still compile.
hubs?a=list and hubs?a=nearest responses include a `bins` array on every hub (empty array when none), with existing fields unchanged.
reportUnfit with destination default returns `destination:'DONOR_SITE'`; with destination:'HUB_BIN' + valid bin_id returns `destination:'HUB_BIN'`, `hub_name`, `hub_address`, `bin_label`.
reportUnfit with a bin whose bin_type does not match the grade returns 400 with message starting 'This bin does not accept'.
routeUnclaimed on another donor's listing, a non-AVAILABLE listing, or a hub listing returns a 4xx with a clear message (does not route).
wasteJobs rows include `pickup_type` ('HUB_BIN' or 'DONOR_SITE') and hub fields for HUB_BIN items.

collect of a single HUB_BIN waste_id sets source_type='HUB' (not DONOR_SITE) and returns ok:1; collect of mixed HUB_BIN+DONOR_SITE (or two different hubs) returns 400 'Collect hub-bin items and donor-site items separately, one hub at a time'.
verification: npm run build (tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build) -> PASS (exit 0)
findings:
COMPLETED. All 3 in-scope files implemented; node --check (hubs.js, data.js) and npm run build (tsc+vite) all pass (exit 0).

ENDPOINT SHAPES (for later feature steps):
- hubs?a=list & hubs?a=nearest: every hub object now has `bins: [{bin_id, bin_type:'ANIMAL'|'BIOGAS', label, max_weight_kg, free_kg}]` (DECIMAL max_weight_kg/free_kg arrive as strings; empty array when none). All existing fields (compartments, available_items, last_checkin, distance_km) unchanged.
- reportUnfit (POST): body gains `destination` ('DONOR_SITE' default | 'HUB_BIN') and `bin_id` (required for HUB_BIN). Response ALWAYS includes `destination`. DONOR_SITE: {partner_name, route_type, kg, destination:'DONOR_SITE'}. HUB_BIN: adds hub_name, hub_address, bin_label. bin_type mismatch -> 400 'This bin does not accept <grade> food' (pre-checked in dropIntoBin); HUB_BIN_DROP trigger failures surface as e.sqlMessage.
- routeUnclaimed (POST, DONOR): body {listing_id, grade, destination?, bin_id?}. Same response shape as reportUnfit. Ownership/state checks return 4xx with clear messages: 'Listing not found' / 'You can only route your own listings' / 'Only AVAILABLE listings can be routed' / 'Hub listings are routed through the hub'. quantity_kg = kg_left (DECIMAL coerced via Number()).
- unclaimed (GET, DONOR): array of {listing_id, food_name, quantity_remaining, quantity_unit, kg_left, expires_at, minutes_left}. minutes_left can be NEGATIVE when expired. Calls maybeAutoRoute first.
- wasteJobs (GET, VOLUNTEER): each row gains pickup_type ('HUB_BIN'|'DONOR_SITE'), hub_id, hub_name, hub_address, bin_label (all null for DONOR_SITE). ORDER BY pickup_type DESC, wr.waste_id. Calls maybeAutoRoute first.
- collect (POST, VOLUNTEER): body unchanged {waste_ids, slot_id, container_id, vehicle_no, weighed_kg}. HUB_BIN-only same hub -> source_type='HUB', hub_id set; DONOR_SITE-only -> source_type='DONOR_SITE', hub_id null; mixed or multi-hub -> 400 {error:'Collect hub-bin items and donor-site items separately, one hub at a time'}. receipt_ref = RCPT-<partnerId>-<ts> unchanged. Response {ok:1, collection_id, receipt_ref} unchanged.

TS TYPES (src/lib/api.ts): new `HubBin` and `UnclaimedItem`; `Hub.bins?: HubBin[]`; `ReportUnfitResponse` now has REQUIRED `destination:'DONOR_SITE'|'HUB_BIN'` + optional hub_name?/hub_address?/bin_label?; `WasteJob` now has REQUIRED `pickup_type` + optional (nullable) hub_id?/hub_name?/hub_address?/bin_label?. NB: destination and pickup_type are REQUIRED on the response types — the API always returns them, so existing callers that read only old fields still compile.

GOTCHAS for later steps:
- reportUnfit & routeUnclaimed capture the WASTE_ROUTING insert id as `wasteId = wrIns.insertId` (this is the `waste_id` FK used in HUB_BIN_DROP).
- Module-level helpers added to api/data.js (after needVolunteerRole, before module.exports): `_lastAutoRoute` + `maybeAutoRoute()` (10-min throttle; calls `CALL sp_route_expired_food()` inside try/catch; invoked from myListings, unclaimed, wasteJobs) and `dropIntoBin(conn, binId, wasteId, grade)` (SELECTs bin_type, throws 'Bin not found' / 'This bin does not accept <grade> food', then INSERT INTO HUB_BIN_DROP (bin_id, waste_id)). Reuse dropIntoBin if later code needs to drop into a bin.
- DECIMAL kg_left / free_kg / max_weight_kg arrive as strings; use n()/Number() in the UI.
- For HUB_BIN responses, hub_name/hub_address/bin_label are fetched AFTER commit (autocommit SELECT on conn before release); return null defensively if the bin row is gone.
- maybeAutoRoute runs BEFORE the role-specific queries in each case (after the `need(...)` auth guard) so only authenticated donors/volunteers trigger it.

OUT OF SCOPE (deferred to later feature steps per plan.md — NOT done here): docs/API.md (plan item 7), scripts/smoke.mjs section 5 (plan item 7), scripts/schema-check.mjs HUB_BIN/HUB_BIN_DROP/v_hub_bin_status (plan item 7), and all frontend UI — DashboardShell nav, Donor.tsx (Unfit/Needs-decision), Volunteer.tsx (WasteRunsTab grouping), Hub.tsx (Waste bins card), HubList.tsx, HubMap.tsx (plan items 4-6). Those steps must consume the types/endpoints above.
